api.append: exclusive flock -> chain/semantic replay -> exact Git HEAD prefix -> append/fsync -> commit only training.jsonl
api.checkpoint: complete candidate bytes copied into content-addressed trainer path; fsync file+dir, then register step/hash/parent/optimizer-RNG/source/data SHA
api.conflicting_tail: different Git prefix/torn JSONL/hash corruption/checkpoint corruption fail closed
api.idempotency: identical accepted checkpoint step + same optimizer/RNG digest returns ALREADY_COMMITTED; conflicting version rejected
api.recovery: post-fsync Git failure leaves valid unsynced suffix; sync commits it, never appends duplicate
api.seal: candidate only, not independently approved, not promoted
api.task_claim: exclusive; lease 7200 seconds; only nonrunning expired claims eligible for takeover

authority.kernel: construction tasks, independent verification and subsequent champion promotion gate
authority.plan_authoring_guard: only trainer plans; one full append-only task record and complete priority snapshot
authority.source_import_guard: only trainer inbox; absolute, no symlinks or traversal
authority.trainer: training task specifications, claims, and candidate checkpoint byte identities only

limitations: No actual neural trainer, service, scheduler, process heartbeat or checkpoint deserializer
Trainer-only CLI path restrictions are not OS confinement against arbitrary same-UID processes
Training task operator evidence is a recorded claim, not authenticated human authorization
Source/data pins in seed canary are zero placeholders; no dataset was loaded
Exactly-once physical gradient computation is unproven for interrupted uncommitted steps
Future NC-046 worker must impose verified process liveness before any active-job takeover
Content-addressed checkpoint bytes excluded from Git; require external backup
No independent scientific quality or model promotion assertion
negative_controls: duplicate conflicting checkpoint and optimizer/RNG digests
post-fsync Git failure, sync and no double-acceptance
restart_protocol: Read AGENTS.md, README.md, SCHEDULE.md, TAB_PROMPT.md and ledger status
Validate chain, replay checkpoints, Git synchronization, tests and claimant
Create unique turn-uuid, use pull; respect HOLD and existing owner lease
Never execute steps already accepted into ledger; verify last checkpoint identity first
Only independently approved future worker may execute training; NC-045 starts no worker
Treat ambiguous crash before checkpoint acceptance as potentially repeated computation
No scientific PASS or upstream promotion without separate verifier

seed_task_snapshot.TR-001: manual synthetic canary, approved for protocol test only
seed_task_snapshot.TR-002: real CPU learning episode, unapproved and dependency-blocked
